movelist.name: Lava Plume
movelist.effect: Lava Plume burns all targets on 16+.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Crunch
movelist.effect: Crunch lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+

movelist.name: Metal Sound
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Special Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Fire Fang
movelist.effect: Fire Fang Burns or Flinches on 18-19 during Accuracy Check; flip a coin to determine whether the foe gets Burned or Flinches. On 20 during Accuracy Check, the foe is Burned and Flinches.

movelist.name: Leer
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Fire-Type attacks. If the user is hit by a Fire-Type attack, they gain +1 CS in their choice of Attack or Special Attack. Defensive.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Melee Attack

abilities.name: Magma Armor
abilities.effect: Whenever a foe hits you with a Melee Attack or ends their turn grappling you, they lose a tick of Hit Points. Foes immune to Burn do not suffer this effect.
